description: This file contains the implementation of order processing services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functions for creating orders, checking permissions, and managing related entities such as order items, adjustments, notes, and inventory reservations.

classes.name: OrderServices
classes.description: Service class providing methods for handling order creation, permission checking, and related operations within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: OrderServices
classes.description: Service class providing methods for handling order creation, permission checking, status updates, notifications, and fulfillment within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to perform a specified action on an order, considering order type, party roles, and security roles.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order, including order header, items, status, adjustments, notes, inventory reservations, and related entities.

methods.name: countProductQuantityOrdered
methods.description: Counts and records the total quantity ordered for a specific product.

methods.name: countProductQuantityOrdered
methods.description: Counts and records the total quantity ordered for a specific product, updating or creating ProductCalculatedInfo entities, and handles recursive virtual product ID updates.

methods.name: reserveInventory
methods.description: Handles inventory reservation logic for order items, including different product types, drop-shipping, and marketing packaging, with detailed validation and error handling.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Retrieves the product name from the product entity or falls back to order item description.

methods.name: determineSingleFacilityFromOrder
methods.description: Determines the facility associated with an order header.

methods.name: resetGrandTotal
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the grandTotal and remainingSubTotal fields on an order header.

methods.name: setEmptyGrandTotals
methods.description: Iterates through orders missing grandTotal and remainingSubTotal, resetting these values by calling resetGrandTotal.

methods.name: recalcOrderTax
methods.description: Recalculates order taxes by invoking the 'calcTax' service, comparing previous and new tax totals, and creating adjustments if needed.

methods.name: recalcOrderShipping
methods.description: Recalculates shipping costs for an order's ship groups, creating adjustments if necessary based on shipping estimate comparisons.

methods.name: checkItemStatus
methods.description: Checks whether all order items are canceled, completed, or approved, and updates order header status accordingly.

methods.name: cancelOrderItem
methods.description: Handles cancellation of specified quantities of order items, with permission checks, entity retrieval, and error handling.

methods.name: cancelOrderItem
methods.description: Handles cancellation of specified quantities of order items, including validation, inventory adjustment, logging, and status updates, with extensive error handling.

methods.name: setItemStatus
methods.description: Changes the status of individual order items, with validation against allowed status transitions and creation of status change records.

methods.name: setOrderStatus
methods.description: Updates the order header status, with permission checks, validation, and logging of status changes.

methods.name: updateTrackingNumber
methods.description: Updates the shipping tracking number for a specified shipment group.

methods.name: addRoleType
methods.description: Adds a role to an order for a party, with optional removal of existing roles of the same type.

methods.name: removeRoleType
methods.description: Removes a specified role from an order for a party.

methods.name: sendOrderConfirmNotification
methods.description: Sends an order confirmation email to the customer.

methods.name: sendOrderCompleteNotification
methods.description: Sends an order completion notification email to the customer.

methods.name: sendOrderBackorderNotification
methods.description: Sends a backorder notification email to the customer.

methods.name: sendOrderChangeNotification
methods.description: Sends an order change notification email to the customer.

methods.name: sendOrderPayRetryNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification email regarding order payment retry results.

methods.name: sendProcessNotification
methods.description: Dispatches an email notification regarding order workflow or processing events.

methods.name: getOrderHeaderInformation
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about an order header.

methods.name: getOrderShippingAmount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total shipping amount for an order.

methods.name: getOrderAddress
methods.description: Retrieves billing and shipping address contact mechanisms associated with an order.

methods.name: createOrderNote
methods.description: Creates a note attached to an order header, associating it with the order and internal notes.

methods.name: allowOrderSplit
methods.description: Enables the splitting of an order shipment group, with permission checking and updating the order shipment group record.

methods.name: cancelFlaggedSalesOrders
methods.description: Automatically cancels sales orders based on configured policies, either due to payment non-receipt or auto-cancel dates on order items.

methods.name: checkDigitalItemFulfillment
methods.description: Validates and processes the fulfillment and invoicing of digital and non-product items within an order.
